column1: 30151§speck§spek§n. 斑点；微粒；一点点§He watches his father raise a kite within minutes into the wind, so high that Gogol must tip his head back in order to see, a rippling speck against the sky.§他看着父亲几分钟内就把风筝放上风里，高得果戈理必须仰起头才看得见——那只是衬在天空上、微微颤动的一个**小点**。§§§§a speck of dust 一粒灰尘§真题 a rippling speck against the sky 以「天空中一个颤动的小点」写风筝升得极高§

30152§susceptibility§səˌseptəˈbɪləti§n. 易感性；易受影响的性质§These animals are thought to be especially vulnerable to ocean acidification due to calcium carbonate's susceptibility to dissolution at lower pH values.§这些动物被认为对海洋酸化尤为脆弱，因为碳酸钙在 pH 值较低时**易于**溶解。§Students in a biology class investigated why individual house mice (Mus musculus) can differ from one another in their susceptibility to cataracts in old age.§一个生物课上的学生小组研究了为什么个别小家鼠（Mus musculus）年老时患白内障的**易感性**各不相同。§§susceptibility to X 对 X 的易感性；susceptible adj. 易受影响的（susceptible to）§vulnerability 强调「易受伤害」，susceptibility 强调「易被影响」§

30153§tempest§ˈtempɪst§n. 暴风雨；狂风暴雨；骚动；风潮§Several games, including the 1981 game Tempest, are playable at the museum, but other games, including the 2003 game Eve Online, are shown only in video footage because they are too complex to exhibit in a playable form.§包括 1981 年的游戏《Tempest》（意为**暴风雨**）在内的几款游戏可在馆内试玩，但另一些游戏（如 2003 年的《Eve Online》）只能以视频形式展示——它们太过复杂，无法以可玩的形式展出。§The poem is a dedication to Puerto Cabello, a town on the northern coast of Venezuela. And while outside the tempest is raving o’er the ocean, And the ship is madly driving on some lone and desert shore; Thy warm and land-locked waters swell with an easy motion, And gently glides the light pirogue [canoe] at dipping of the oar.§这首诗是献给委内瑞拉北部海岸小镇波多卡贝洛的颂歌。任凭外面**风暴**在海上狂啸，任凭船儿疯狂地漂向孤寂荒凉的海岸；你温暖而闭锁的港湾水面轻柔起伏，轻舟在船桨起落间缓缓滑行。§§a tempest of protest 抗议风潮；tempestuous adj. 暴风雨般的；动荡激烈的；The Tempest 《暴风雨》（莎士比亚剧作，真题文本常客）§带文学 / 古语色彩，现代英语多用 storm§改例句：1981 与 game 间漏空格；改译文：游戏名后补「意为暴风雨」；改例句2：诗行换行处漏空格（ocean,And、shore;Thy、motion,And）

30154§tenable§ˈtenəbl§adj. （论点、立场）站得住脚的；可维持的；（职位、阵地）可保持的§However, literary-critical methodologies in particular make assumptions about authorial control that to be tenable must be restricted to forms like novels, poems, and plays.§然而，尤其是文学批评方法，其对作者控制权所作的假定若要**站得住脚**，就必须被限定在小说、诗歌、戏剧这类形式之内。§Luu et al. point out, the singular nature of impact ejection makes it untenable as an account of multiple loss episodes of similar duration over several years.§正如 Luu 等人指出的，撞击喷出是一次性的事件，用它来解释数年间多次时长相近的损失事件**站不住脚**。§§tenable position / assumption 站得住脚的立场 / 假定；untenable adj. 站不住脚的（反义）；tenability n. 可维持性；tenure n. 任期；终身教职（同根 ten- 持有）；defensible adj. 可辩护的；viable adj. 可行的（近义）§§改译文2：singular 指「一次性」，原译「奇异性」不对，并补出 untenable

30155§textual§ˈtekstʃuəl§adj. 文本的；与文本有关的§The many editions of James Joyce's 1922 novel Ulysses are not textually identical, and scholars debate which versions reflect Joyce's authorial intent.§詹姆斯·乔伊斯 1922 年的小说《尤利西斯》的众多版本在**文本上**并不完全一致，学者们争论哪些版本才体现了乔伊斯的作者原意。§The student wants to include two pieces of textual evidence that demonstrate people reacting in similar ways to this sensibility of Owen's.§该学生想引用两处**文本**证据，证明人们对欧文这种气质的反应如出一辙。§text（编织→文本）+ -ual§textual evidence / analysis / variant 文本证据 / 分析 / 异文；text n. 文本（真题题干高频：Text 1 / Text 2）；context n. 语境；subtext n. 潜台词（同根）§textual「文本的」≠ texture「质地；纹理」，形近异义§改译文：原译「1922年以来的众多版本」与英文不符，1922 是小说出版年

30156§transpire§trænˈspaɪə(r)§v. 发生；（事情）被人知晓；（植物）蒸腾；散发（水汽）§… but now the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside any one fence was something to be repudiated with contempt …§……可如今一想到所有这些狂暴与骚动竟然都**发生**在同一道栅栏之内，就让人不由得要以轻蔑的态度加以否定……§§§§It transpired that… 后来才知道…；transpiration n. 蒸腾（作用）；occur 发生；come to light 曝光（近义）§transpire 与 inspire / aspire / conspire 同含词根 spir-（呼吸），易混§改译文：英文首尾是省略号，删去英文里没有的前后两部分

30157§whirl§wɜːl§v. 急速打转；回旋 n. 一阵忙乱§In rural Alabama, a man referred to as the stranger is walking among a group of untamed calico (spotted) horses that he has penned in a lot. [The horses] whipped and whirled about the lot like dizzy fish in a bowl.§在阿拉巴马乡间，一个被称作「陌生人」的男子正走在一群被他圈在围栏里的野性花斑马之间——[马群]像碗里晕头转向的鱼一样，在圈里甩尾**打转**。§§§§a whirl of activity 一阵忙乱；give it a whirl 试一试§§改译文：rural Alabama 原译成密西西比

30158§woefully§ˈwəʊfəli§adv. 极为（糟糕地）；可怜地；令人遗憾地§Meanwhile, the work of Dorothy Parker, who relied on conventional poetic forms associated with previous literary periods, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.§与此同时，多萝西·帕克的作品因沿用与先前文学时期相关的传统诗体，只吸引到现代主义研究者少得**可怜**的关注。§Meanwhile, John Steinbeck's Of Mice and Men, whose coherent, linear narrative structure recalls the fiction of previous centuries, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.§与此同时，约翰·斯坦贝克的《人鼠之间》——其连贯的线性叙事结构令人想起前几个世纪的小说——从现代主义学者那里得到的关注少得**可怜**。§woe（悲哀）+ -ful + -ly§woefully inadequate / little / unaware 严重不足 / 少得可怜 / 全然不知；woeful adj. 糟糕的；悲哀的；sadly / deplorably adv. 令人遗憾地（近义）§书面强调副词，带「令人遗憾」色彩§改例句2：删去混入的 Text 2 一句；改译文2：删去对应译文，并译出 woefully little

30159§accentuate§əkˈsentʃueɪt§v. 使更突出；使更明显；强调§The camera’s presence is continually accentuated by showing the operator positioning it, for example, placing it atop a steel structure, where he then adjusts the camera to capture a view of traffic passing underneath, to which the film cuts immediately after.§影片不断通过展示操作员架设机器的过程来**凸显**摄影机的存在，例如把它架在一座钢构上、再调整机位以拍到下方车流，随后镜头立刻切到那个画面。§§§accent n. 重音 → accentuate v.§accentuate the presence of X 凸显 X 的存在§与 emphasize 同义，但更偏「通过对比 / 反复呈现来凸显」§

30160§acquaint§əˈkweɪnt§v. 使熟悉；使了解§The untaught peasant beheld the elements around him and was acquainted with their practical uses.§未受教育的农人观察周身万物，**熟悉**它们的实际用途。§§§§be acquainted with 熟悉；了解；acquaint oneself with 主动去了解；acquaintance n. 熟人；略知§别与 acquire（获得）混淆§改译文：删去英文没有的背景说明（弗兰肯斯坦叙述）和「只」

30161§actuality§ˌæktʃuˈæləti§n. 现实；实际存在；真实性§However, some differentiate between members of the dynasty like Wladyslaw I Herman, who ruled as duke from 1079 to 1102 CE, and less well-documented figures like Lestek, who is said to have ruled in the 9th and 10th centuries but whose historical actuality is disputed.§不过，也有人把王朝中像 1079 至 1102 年在位的公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫一世这类有明确记载者，与莱斯特克这类据称在 9、10 世纪统治却记载寥寥、其历史**真实性**仍受质疑的人物区分开来。§§§§historical actuality 历史真实性；in actuality 实际上（= in fact，书面）；actualize v. 实现（真题出现 11 次）§与 potentiality（可能性）相对§

30162§affluent§ˈæfluənt§adj. 富裕的；充裕的§The affluent accepted fines as merely a tax on privilege, even as the amounts increased with frequent revisions to the laws.§**富裕阶层**把罚款仅仅当作对特权征收的一项税，即便随着法律频繁修订，罚金数额也水涨船高。§Reexamining these data, Gregory Clark notes that while inventories from the period appear consistent with the consumer-revolution argument, the proportion of the population whose wills included such documentation decreased considerably between 1600 and 1750, with this documentation increasingly representing more affluent individuals.§重新审视这些数据时，Gregory Clark 指出：虽然该时期的财产清单看似支持「消费革命」的论点，但遗嘱中含此类记录的人口比例在 1600 至 1750 年间大幅下降，这类记录越来越多地只代表更**富裕**的人群。§ad-（向）+ flu（流）→ 流向你 → 富足§the affluent 富裕阶层；affluence n. 富裕；fluent adj. 流利的；fluid adj. 流动的（同根 flu- 流）§§

30163§agglomeration§əˌɡlɒməˈreɪʃn§n. 聚集（体）；集聚；（城市）连片扩张区§Rudolf Cesaretti et al. conducted an analysis of historical urban scaling trends circa 1300 CE in Western Europe, focusing on agglomeration patterns within medieval settlements.§Rudolf Cesaretti 等人分析了公元1300年前后西欧历史上的城市规模变化趋势，重点关注中世纪聚落内部的**集聚**模式。§Although the clustering of cutlery manufacturing firms in Sheffield, UK, is often cited as typical of industrial agglomeration.§尽管英国谢菲尔德餐具制造企业的聚集常被引为工业**集聚**的典型……§§agglomeration economies 集聚经济；agglomerate v. 聚集 n. 集合体；aggregate n. 聚合体；aggregation n. 聚集（近义，真题另现）§§

30164§aggregation§ˌæɡrɪˈɡeɪʃn§n. 聚集（体）；集合体；汇总；加总§Among tree species in the Mo Singto plot (latitude 14.26°N) and other tropical forest sites, there is little correlation between conspecific aggregation and the abundance of a given species in the wider local area, so RSA is expected, but in the Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute (latitude 38.89°N) and other temperate forest sites, the aggregation-abundance correlation for tree species is strongly negative.§在 Mo Singto 样地（纬度 14.26°N）及其他热带森林样地，树种的同种**聚集**度与该物种在更大局域范围内的丰盛度几乎没有相关性；而在史密森尼保护生物学研究所（纬度 38.89°N）及其他温带森林样地，树种的聚集—丰盛度相关性则呈强负值。§§§§an aggregation of 一群…；data aggregation 数据聚合；aggregate v./n./adj. 合计（的）；aggregator n. 聚合器；整合平台§§

30165§allude§əˈluːd§v. 暗指；影射；间接提及§Amos Barton.” In the text, the narrator addresses the reader directly and alludes to a discussion among Rev.§……Amos Barton》。文中叙述者直接向读者说话，并**暗指**牧师（Rev.）……之间的一场讨论。§For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Corozal has also been called “the Cradle of Volleyball,” a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: being a longtime volleyball powerhouse.§再如，波多黎各的科罗萨尔市也被称为「排球摇篮」——这个别名的**所指**正是该地为人熟知之处：长盛不衰的排球重镇。§§allude to 暗指；间接提及（不点名）；allusion n. 典故；暗指（真题高频文学术语）；allusive adj. 含典故的；爱用暗示的§allude（暗指）≠ elude（逃避；使记不起）≠ refer to（直接指称）§改译文：原译是另一句（英尼斯画铁路）的翻译，按英文（残句）重译

30166§amalgam§əˈmælɡəm§n. 混合物；融合体；汞齐（牙科填充合金）§A creole language is an amalgam of a lexifier, or primary contributor of grammar and vocabulary, with one or more substrates, or secondary contributors.§克里奥尔语是「词汇供给语」（语法与词汇的主要来源）与一个或多个「底层语」（次要来源）融合而成的**混合体**。§§§§an amalgam of A with B A 与 B 的融合体§真题用来定义克里奥尔语（creole）「词汇供给语 + 底层语」的结构§

30167§aria§ˈɑːriə§n. 咏叹调（歌剧中的独唱曲）§They omitted parts, such as the aria “I Got Plenty of Nuthin'," and sometimes made only brief gestures toward Gershwin's melodies.§他们删掉了部分内容，比如那首**咏叹调**《我一无所有也有余》，有时只是对格什温的旋律略作示意。§§§§opera n. 歌剧；libretto n. 歌剧脚本（真题同域词）§aria（独唱咏叹调）≠ recitative（宣叙调）≠ arioso（咏叙调）；aria ≠ area：形近异义§

30168§anomalous§əˈnɒmələs§adj. 反常的；异常的§In her 2012 analysis of tree rings from Japan's Yaku Island, cosmic ray physicist Fusa Miyake noted an anomalous carbon-14 spike dating to 774-775 CE, indicating that a massive burst of radiation reached Earth during that time.§在 2012 年对日本屋久岛树轮的分析中，宇宙射线物理学家三宅芙沙观测到一次**反常**的碳-14 峰值，其年代可追溯至公元 774–775 年，表明当时有一场巨大的辐射暴抵达地球。§No other known heating mechanism on Jupiter could account for the formation of this anomalous structure, so one hypothesis considered was that it was ejected from the auroral region toward the equator.§木星上没有其他已知的加热机制能解释这一**反常**结构的形成，因此有一种假说认为它是从极光区被抛射到赤道地区的。§希腊 an-（不）+ homalos（平的；一致的）→「不一致的」§anomaly n. 反常；异常（neoclassical economics cannot explain anomalies 无法解释这些反常现象）；anomalously adv. 反常地§§改音标：美音 ɑː 改为英音 ɒ；原书错：构词写成 a- + nomal（= normal），实为希腊 an- + homalos；改译文：Fusa Miyake 是三宅芙沙，原译写成三宅真

30169§ascend§əˈsend§v. 上升；攀登；登上§And then Boston tilts away and they ascend effortlessly over a blackened Atlantic.§接着波士顿倾斜着远去，他们毫不费力地**升上**黑沉沉的大西洋上空。§This work of public art depicts a staircase that appears to ascend into the clouds.§这件公共艺术作品描绘了一道仿佛**直上**云霄的阶梯。§a-（向）+ scend（爬）→ 往上爬§ascend the throne 登上王位；ascent n. 上升；上坡路；ascendant adj. 上升的；占优势的；descend v. 下降（反义同根）§§
30170§astound§əˈstaʊnd§v. 使大吃一惊；使震惊§He was the astounding, inconceivable growth of his locality.§他本身就是那片乡土**令人惊愕**、难以想象的生长。§§§§be astounded by 对…大吃一惊；astounding adj. 令人惊骇的§语气强于 surprise，接近 stagger§

30171§augment§ɔːɡˈment§v. 增强；扩大；补充§Vascularity and other identifying characteristics of pneumatic diverticula tend not to fossilize, so paleontologists have relied on studies of living bird species to document these qualities, augmenting their findings from fossil analysis to glean additional insights into the respiratory systems of extinct genera such as Tyrannosaurus, Euhelopus, and other Cretaceous theropods and sauropods that may have also exhibited PSP.§气囊憩室（pneumatic diverticula）的血管分布及其他识别特征往往不会形成化石，因此古生物学家依靠对现生鸟类的研究来记录这些特征，用以**补充**化石分析的发现，从而进一步了解霸王龙属、盘足龙属（Euhelopus）以及其他可能同样具有 PSP 的白垩纪兽脚类和蜥脚类等已灭绝类群的呼吸系统。§§§§augment A with B 用 B 扩充 A；augmented reality（AR）增强现实（真题搭配）；augmentation n. 增强；增补；supplement v. 补充；amplify v. 放大（近义）§augment ≠ argument：形近，拼写易混§改译文：原译是另一句（亲生物设计）的翻译，按英文重译

30172§auspicious§ɔːˈspɪʃəs§adj. 吉利的；吉祥的；兆头好的§Adam is meeting his great-uncle Richard at a port. The meeting so auspiciously begun proceeded well.§亚当正在港口与叔祖父理查德会面。这场开局如此**顺利**的会面，此后也进行得颇为融洽。§§§auspice n. 预兆；赞助 → auspicious§an auspicious beginning 良好的开端；auspiciously adv. 吉利地；inauspicious adj. 不吉利的（反义）§§

30173§backwater§ˈbækwɔːtə§n. （河流主道旁的）回水湾；死水；（贬）闭塞落后的地方§Al Black’s Sunset Backwater Scene with Egrets, a wetland landscape with silhouettes of moss-covered trees contrasted by a vibrant orange sky, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, loosely affiliated landscape artists mainly active in Fort Pierce, Florida, during the 1950s and ’60s.§阿尔·布莱克的《白鹭落日**回水**景》描绘湿地风光，以苔树剪影映衬鲜亮的橙红天幕，是「佛罗里达公路客」画派的典型作品——这群联系松散的画家主要活跃于 1950 至 60 年代的佛州皮尔斯堡。§§§§§真题以画作名 Sunset Backwater Scene 出现§改译文：补漏译的 wetland landscape

30174§bazaar§bəˈzɑː(r)§n. 集市；市场；义卖§Even at ten in the morning, the bazaar was throbbing with activity.§即便上午十点，**集市**也已是一片熙熙攘攘。§§§§charity bazaar 慈善义卖；marketplace n. 市场；souk n. （阿拉伯）露天市场§bazaar ≠ bizarre：形近异义，读音也不同，后者是「古怪的」§改译文：删去英文没有的背景句

30175§bottleneck§ˈbɒtlnek§n. 瓶颈；阻碍进展的环节；（种群）瓶颈效应§Although efficiencies in long-distance transport of parcels have greatly improved delivery times, last-mile logistics (the final step in delivery to consumers) present a bottleneck for delivery companies.§尽管长途包裹运输的效率提升大幅缩短了配送时间，但最后一公里物流（送达消费者的最后环节）仍给快递公司造成了**瓶颈**。§Delivery companies are contending with the increasing popularity of next-day delivery and with the increasing volume of parcels to be delivered, resulting in a growing bottleneck of packages in the last-mile delivery stage.§快递公司正疲于应对「次日达」日益流行的趋势与不断增长的包裹量，导致末端配送环节的包裹积压（**瓶颈**）日益加剧。§§create / present a bottleneck 造成瓶颈；constraint n. 制约；impediment n. 阻碍（近义）§bottleneck ≠ backlog：后者是「积压（的工作）」§

30176§bramble§ˈbræmbl§n. （悬钩子属）多刺灌木；荆棘丛§Soil thawing in Alaska has been accelerating as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of arctic bramble (Rubus arcticus) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂ output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).§阿拉斯加的冻土融化因气候变化而加速，一方面可能通过北极**悬钩子**等植被生产力提升而增加二氧化碳吸收，另一方面也可能通过土壤微生物活动产生的异养呼吸增加二氧化碳排放。§§§§arctic bramble 北极悬钩子；brambly adj. 多刺的（也形容味道带野果的涩感）§§

30177§bristle§ˈbrɪsl§n. 短硬毛；刷毛；刚毛 v. 恼怒；（毛发）竖起；密布§Like all species of baleen whales, the common minke whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristle like keratin structures called baleen plates.§与所有须鲸一样，普通小须鲸以名为磷虾的微小生物为食：靠名叫「鲸须板」的、由角蛋白构成的**刚毛**状结构过滤海水。§Permafrost in Alaska has been degrading, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO2) absorption through greater productivity of bristle-pointed iris (Iris setoso) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO2 output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO2 generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).§阿拉斯加的永久冻土一直在退化，这可能通过**刚毛**鸢尾等植被更高的生产力增加二氧化碳吸收，也可能通过更强的异养呼吸（土壤微生物活动产生的 CO₂）增加二氧化碳排放。§§bristle-like structures 刚毛状结构；bristle at 因…而恼怒；bristle with 密布着…§§改译文：known as krill 原译「磷虾等」；改译文2：bristle-pointed iris 原译「毛鸢尾」漏了 bristle，改为「刚毛鸢尾」

30178§brusque§bruːsk§adj. （态度、言辞）生硬无礼的；唐突的；不耐烦的§There is no denying that, since he was rather brusque in his ways, he never spared the young authors who asked his advice and read him their productions, but criticized vigorously, even to the verge of insult.§无可否认，由于他行事相当**生硬**，前来讨教、把习作念给他听的年轻作者从不被他留情，反而会被严厉批评，几近羞辱。§§§§brusqueness n. 生硬无礼§比 blunt 更带「不给人留余地」的粗率感§

30179§celerity§səˈlerəti§n. 迅速；敏捷§… he merely moved with a light-poised and watchful celerity, weaving among the calico rushes of the animals …§……他只是以一种轻盈、警觉而**迅捷**的姿态移动，在牲畜斑驳的涌动中穿行……§§§§move with celerity 迅速行动；accelerate v. 加速（同根 celer- 快）§文学 / 正式语体；celerity「动作之快」≠ velocity「物理速度」≠ alacrity「乐意之快」；celerity ≠ celebrity：后者是「名人」§改译文：英文首尾是省略号，删去英文里没有的前后部分

30180§clammy§ˈklæmi§adj. 湿冷的；黏湿的§On every rail and gate, wet lay clammy, and the marsh mist was so thick, that the wooden finger on the post directing people to our village--a direction which they never accepted, for they never came there--was invisible to me until I was quite close under it.§每一道栏杆、每一扇门上，湿气都**黏冷**地凝着；沼雾浓得让路牌上指向我们村子的木指（那方向人们从不理会，因为他们从没来过）直到我走到跟前才看得见。§§§§clammy hands 湿冷的手；a clammy morning 湿冷的早晨§真题 wet lay clammy 是狄更斯式倒装，写栏杆门扉上那层黏冷的水气§

30181§clique§kliːk§n. （排外的）小集团；小圈子；派系§… to make it efficient outside the clique of the cultivated and learned, yet still remaining the best knowledge and thought of the time …§……使它能在有学养者的**小圈子**之外同样生效，却仍不失为时代最好的知识与思想……§§§§cliquish adj. 排他成性的§带贬义，区别于中性的 group / circle§改译文：英文只是中间一段，删去英文里没有的前后部分

30182§cobble§ˈkɒbl§n. 鹅卵石；圆石 v. 草草拼凑§Nearly all implements were fashioned from limestone—mostly from beach cobbles—rather than superior chert or obsidian, and the assemblages predominantly comprise flakes produced through direct percussion, with negligible representation of cores, blades, or retouched tools.§几乎所有器具都用石灰岩打制——大多取自海滩**卵石**——而非更优质的燧石或黑曜岩；这批器物组合以直接打击产生的石片为主，石核、石叶与修整工具极少。§§§§cobblestone n. 铺路卵石；cobble together 草草拼凑；beach cobbles 海滩卵石（真题中是石器原料）§§

30183§coherence§kəʊˈhɪərəns§n. 连贯（性）；一致（性）；（物理）相干性§Standardization of the meaning of culture is a worthwhile goal that would increase the coherence of the discipline.§把文化的含义加以标准化是一个值得追求的目标，它将提升这门学科的内部**一致性**。§For too long, scholars have focused on narrative fragmentation versus coherence, inhibiting inquiry into other points of stylistic correspondence among works that would enrich our understanding of the modernist canon.§长期以来，学者们纠缠于「叙事的碎裂与**连贯**」之争，阻碍了对作品间其他风格对应点的探究——而这些对应点本可丰富我们对现代主义经典的理解。§§narrative coherence 叙事连贯；coherent adj. 连贯的；coherently adv. 连贯地；incoherence n. 不连贯（反义）§cohesion（凝聚力，真题另现）偏「黏合、团结」，coherence 偏逻辑上的连贯一致§

30184§cohesion§kəʊˈhiːʒn§n. 凝聚（力）；团结；内聚；附着（力）§However, it hasn’t been clear how to foster strong group cohesion to motivate prosocial behavior at a global level given that humans tend to align more locally, from family to nationality.§然而，鉴于人类的认同往往更偏向本地层面——从家庭到民族国家——如何在全球层面培育强大的群体**凝聚力**以激发亲社会行为，一直不甚清楚。§The cohesion species concept, described in 1985 by Templeton, defines species in accordance with phenotypic cohesion.§**凝聚**种概念由 Templeton 于 1985 年提出，依据表型凝聚来界定物种。§§group / social cohesion 群体 / 社会凝聚力；cohesive adj. 有凝聚力的§coherence 偏逻辑 / 结构上的前后一致；物理语境常与 adhesion（黏附）对照§

30185§conceivable§kənˈsiːvəbl§adj. 可想象的；可能的§It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.§大自然仿佛决心要给那些试图把世界两大洋连接起来的人，设置一切**可以想见**的障碍。§§§conceive + -able§every conceivable obstacle 一切可想到的障碍（真题）；inconceivable adj. 不可想象的（反义）；conceivably adv. 可能地；conceive v. 构想；设想（真题出现 9 次）§§

30186§confine§kənˈfaɪn§v. 限制；把…局限于；禁闭；关押§While contemporary rapid assessment techniques have advanced this process by allowing numerous candidates to be tested quickly, these methods remain confined to examining known substances.§尽管当代的快速评估技术通过允许快速测试大量候选物推进了这一过程，这些方法仍**局限于**检测已知物质。§Although these are impressive velocities, they are not sufficient to overcome the confining forces of the Sun’s gravity and magnetic field, so the material is pulled back down.§尽管这些速度相当可观，却不足以挣脱太阳引力与磁场的**束缚**，物质因此被重新拉回。§§be confined to 仅限于；confinement n. 限制；监禁；confining forces 约束力（真题天体物理搭配）§confine ≠ define / refine：形近异义§

30187§contemplation§ˌkɒntəmˈpleɪʃn§n. 沉思；凝视；审度§Moreover, she seeks to cultivate a practice of “constant evolution” untethered from any prescriptive agenda, so that her art navigates a liminal space between tradition and autobiography, community and itinerancy, and activism and contemplation.§此外，她试图养成一种不受任何规定性议程束缚的「持续演化」实践，让她的艺术游走于传统与自传、社群与漂泊、行动与**沉思**之间的阈限地带。§§§contemplate v. 凝视；考虑 → contemplation n.§activism and contemplation 行动与沉思（真题对举）§与 meditation 相比更偏「对象化的观照」§

30188§contingent§kənˈtɪndʒənt§adj. 视…而定的；偶然的；非必然的 n. （派遣的）一批人员§Using hydrogen produced with renewable energy (green hydrogen) can help reduce a country’s industrial carbon emissions, but scaling to meet growing demand is contingent on having sufficient space for renewable energy infrastructure.§使用由可再生能源生产的氢气（绿氢）有助于降低一个国家的工业碳排放，但要扩大规模以满足不断增长的需求，则**取决于**是否有足够的空间来建设可再生能源基础设施。§§§§contingent on / upon 视…而定；contingent truth 偶然真理；a contingent of troops 一支分遣队§§

30189§convergent§kənˈvɜːdʒənt§adj. 趋同的；汇合的；会聚的§Protas and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution - a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages - can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages.§Protas 及其同事探讨了**趋同**演化——即同一性状在两个生殖隔离的谱系中各自独立演化出来的现象——如何可能源自两个谱系共有的遗传机制。§§§con-（共同）+ verge（倾向）+ -ent§convergent evolution 趋同演化；converge v. 汇聚；convergence n. 趋同（真题演化类高频）；divergent adj. 分歧的（反义，真题亦现）§§

30190§facile§ˈfæsaɪl§adj. 轻易得来的；肤浅的；轻率的，想当然的§Its very situation—withdrawn a little behind the facile splendours of St. Pancras—implied a comment on the materialism of life.§它（国王十字车站）所处的位置——稍稍退隐在圣潘克拉斯车站那**轻易得来**的华美之后——本身就含蓄地评论了生活的物质主义。§§§§facile splendours 轻易得来的华美；a facile assumption 想当然的假定§facile ≠ easy：easy 是中性的，facile 多带贬义，暗示省事所以不深刻；facilitate v. 促进、facility n. 设施 与它同源，但意思已分化§

30191§crystalline§ˈkrɪstəlaɪn§adj. 晶体的；结晶的；清澈透明的§Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure held stable by the presence of nickel and nitrogen.§与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢具有面心立方的**晶体**结构，靠镍和氮的存在保持稳定。§Most of the ice found on Earth is ice Ih, distinguished by a crystalline structure in which molecules form a hexagonal pattern.§地球上大部分的冰是冰 Ih，其**晶格**结构的特征是分子呈六边形排列。§§crystalline structure 晶体结构；crystalline water 清澈的水；crystal n. 晶体；crystallization n. 结晶§crystallized 指「已结晶的；糖渍的」§

30192§decibel§ˈdesɪbel§n. 分贝（声音强度单位，dB）§Maya Elena Ruiz and colleagues conducted a study comparing musicians and nonmusicians in the volume, measured in decibels (dB), that they preferred when listening to various audio recordings, including solo piano pieces, symphonic works, and ocean sounds.§Maya Elena Ruiz 及其同事开展了一项研究，比较音乐人与非音乐人在聆听各类录音（包括钢琴独奏曲、交响乐作品和海浪声）时偏好的音量（以**分贝**（dB）计）。§§§deci-（十分之一）+ bel（贝尔）§decibel level 分贝值；in decibels 以分贝计（真题固定搭配）；amplitude n. 振幅；frequency n. 频率（同域物理量）§§改译文：原译人名和录音内容都是另一句的，按英文重译

30193§deduce§dɪˈdjuːs§v. 推断；演绎§It is impossible to deduce anything about George Inness’s attitude toward his subject in the painting The Lackawanna Valley, primarily because it is a commissioned work.§要**推断**乔治·英尼斯在画作《拉卡瓦纳山谷》中对其描绘对象的态度是不可能的，主要因为这是一件委托作品。§Agee recounts driving a car through an area of rural Alabama that he is unfamiliar with. On which road the woods might give way to any extension of farm country there was no deducing: for we were somewhere toward the middle of one of the wider gaps on the road map, and had seen nothing but woods, and infrequent woods farms, for a good while now.§Agee 讲述了自己开车穿行阿拉巴马乡村陌生地带的经历。在哪条路上树林会让位于延伸的农田，无从**推断**：我们正处在地图上一处较宽的空白地带的中段，好一阵子除了树林和零星的林间农场，什么也没见到。§§deduce A from B 从 B 推断出 A；deduction n. 推论；演绎；deductive adj. 演绎的；infer v. 推断（近义，真题亦现）§deduce（演绎，从一般到个别）≠ induce（归纳，从个别到一般）§改例句：删去混入的 Text 1 末句和「Text 2」标签；改译文：补漏译的 primarily because it is a commissioned work；改译文2：On which road 原译成「这条路两旁…何处」

30194§deem§diːm§v. 认为；视为§Even famed film editor Thelma Schoonmaker, winner of multiple BAFTAs and recipient of the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement in 2014, is constrained by the footage available to her and will, at times, knowingly include shots with what are often deemed continuity “errors,” as was the case in The Aviator (2004), which includes a scene depicting Howard Hughes and Faith Domergue sharing a chocolate sundae.§连屡获英国电影学院奖、2014 年获威尼斯电影节终身成就金狮奖的著名剪辑师 Thelma Schoonmaker，也受限于手头可用的素材，有时会明知故用一些通常被**视为**穿帮「失误」的镜头——《飞行家》（2004）即有一幕呈现 Howard Hughes 与 Faith Domergue 共享巧克力圣代。§Jevons deems a "double coincidence of wants"—in other words, each trading party must want precisely what the other has.§杰文斯**认为**需要「需求的双重巧合」——换言之，交易的每一方都恰好想要对方拥有的东西。§§be deemed (to be) 被视为；deem it necessary to… 认为有必要…（真题常见句式）§deem 是「经判断而认定」，比 think / consider 更正式、更有权威色彩；deem ≠ doom：后者是「厄运；注定」§

30195§delimit§diːˈlɪmɪt§v. 确定…的边界；划定…的范围§Moreover, the manuscript lacks any paratextual apparatus—titles, commentary, lists of solutions—to delimit riddles, and the appearance of a distinctive mark to signal the ends of some riddles may be an unreliable clue.§此外，这份手稿没有任何副文本装置——标题、评注、答案表——来**划定**各则谜语的边界；而用来标示某些谜语结尾的特殊记号，也未必是可靠的线索。§§§de- + limit → delimit§delimitation n. 划界；定界§与 define 相比更强调「画出物理 / 文本边界」§

30196§demeanour§dɪˈmiːnə§n. 举止；风度；仪态§He had not the great talents of his younger brothers, but he exceeded them in judgment and propriety of demeanour; his fault, if he had one, was an over-attention to words instead of things; there was a thought too much finesse about him, and, as even his father sometimes told him, he was too fond of a compromise.§他不及几位弟弟才华出众，却在判断力与**举止**得体上胜过他们；若说有什么缺点，便是过于留意字句而非事情本身，心思太绕，连父亲有时也说他太爱折中妥协。§§§§propriety of demeanour 举止得体（真题 judgment and propriety of demeanour 写人物长于分寸）§英式拼写，美式作 demeanor§

30197§deterrent§dɪˈterənt§n. 威慑物；起阻止作用的事物 adj. 威慑性的§Noting which termites the spiders first looked at and which termites they ultimately targeted, the researchers concluded that contrasting markings were a deterrent.§研究者记录了蜘蛛首先注视哪些白蚁、最终又锁定哪些白蚁，据此得出结论：反差鲜明的斑纹起到了**威慑**作用。§Aware of some practical limitations of reflective elements and other common deterrents, Qing Chen et al. investigated the utility of an inexpensive, easily installed sonic bird repeller in a pear orchard.§意识到反光装置等常见**驱鸟手段**存在实际局限，Qing Chen 等人在一片梨园中研究了廉价且易于安装的声学驱鸟器的效果。§§a deterrent to / against 对…的威慑；deterrent effect 威慑作用；deter v. 阻止；威慑；deterrence n. 威慑；repellent n. 驱避剂（真题同域词，如 sonic bird repeller）§§

30198§digression§daɪˈɡreʃn§n. 离题；题外话；枝节§While the first book’s chapters all contribute to bolstering a clear, coherent argument about income inequality, the second book’s digressions on subjects such as the authorship of the Sanskrit text known as the Manusmriti do not just stretch out the book needlessly but also muddy its reasoning.§第一本书各章都在合力支撑一个关于收入不平等的清晰连贯论点，第二本书却**岔开**去谈《摩奴法典》作者归属之类的题目，不只把书无谓地拉长，还把论证搅浑了。§§§digress v. 离题 → digression§digressions on… 关于…的离题话§真题用 do not just stretch out the book but muddy its reasoning 点明其危害§

30199§dilution§daɪˈluːʃn§n. 稀释；冲淡；（股权）摊薄§Vegetation has two primary mechanisms by which it reduces air pollution: deposition (absorption of pollutants) and, the more effective, dispersion (dilution of pollutants by ventilation).§植被减少空气污染主要靠两种机制：沉降（吸收污染物）和更有效的扩散（通过通风**稀释**污染物）。§§§§dilution of pollutants 污染物的稀释；dilute v. 稀释 adj. 稀释的§dilution ≠ delusion：后者是「错觉」，形近异义§

30200§dissect§dɪˈsekt§v. 解剖；剖析；仔细分析§He might dissect, anatomise, and give names; but, not to speak of a final cause, causes in their secondary and tertiary grades were utterly unknown to him.§他或许能**解剖**、能作细致分析、能一一命名；但且不说终极原因，就连第二层、第三层的原因，他也全然无知。§§§§§真题 dissect, anatomise, and give names 与「只知其表、不解其因」对举§
